title: Utility tariffs
description: The published utility rates that cap what tenants may charge (D-021a, D-140). A version is entered by one person, verified against the source by a second and then published.
workflowHint: Entered by one person, verified against the published source by a second, then published.
secondPersonBody: You entered this version, so another platform user must verify it against the source.
needsCheckBody: The maker marked values that still need confirmation against the source document.
diffHint: Every value that differs between two versions.
noDiff: The two versions are the same.
sampleHint: The API's charge of a consumption at a version (excluding VAT), next to the version in force.
sampleEmpty: Type a consumption to see the bill at this tariff.

editor.title: New version of {name}
editor.description: Type the values exactly as the utility publishes them. A second person verifies them before they are published.
editor.entered: Version entered; it waits for a second person
editor.sourceUrlHint: The utility's page or announcement the values come from
editor.sourceDocumentHint: PDF or a photo of the utility's announcement — kept with the version for the checker
editor.ceilingHint: Highest marginal rate + Ft, excluding VAT — the hint shown to owners
editor.needsCheckHint: Paths separated by commas, e.g. ft.pricePerUnit

tier.order: Must be above the previous tier
tier.lastOpen: The last tier has no upper bound

workflow.verifyBody: Compare every value with the published source ({source}). You cannot verify a version you entered.
workflow.checkedAgainstSource: I compared every value with the source
workflow.publishBody: From {date} this version caps tenants' rates; the version in force then is closed. Type the date to confirm.
